method: Personally inspected every image in 87 contact sheets built from actual full-course review screenshots, including model toolbars, diagrams, case controls, active states, and model notes.
Full-context PNGs were grouped only when their complete original file bytes shared SHA-256. No acceptance was transferred from focused captures or by approximate pixel similarity.
Checked visible labels and their association, circle and line visibility, marks, clipping, readable case buttons, active case state, and text wrapping.
Reopened theory-40 case-3 at native full size to resolve apparent contact-sheet clipping; its actual screenshot has complete controls and text.
limits: Desktop selfchecks 16–30 are reviewed separately by theory_full_desktop_late; this reviewer does not claim to have personally viewed that scope.
This supplement evaluates actual full-course images and controls; it does not repeat source transcription or mathematical proof review.
